definitions.explanation: A type of cloud forming a uniform gray or blue-gray sheet at middle altitudes (roughly 2,000–7,000 meters), often indicating approaching rain.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{高層雲|こうそううん}に{覆|おお}われている。
examples.english: The sky is covered by altostratus clouds.

examples.japanese: {高層雲|こうそううん}が{広|ひろ}がると{雨|あめ}が{近|ちか}いことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When altostratus spreads, rain is often approaching.

examples.japanese: {天気予報|てんきよほう}では{午後|ごご}から{高層雲|こうそううん}が{厚|あつ}くなり、{夕方|ゆうがた}には{雨|あめ}になると{伝|つた}えていた。
examples.english: The weather forecast said the altostratus would thicken from the afternoon and turn to rain by evening.

notes:
One of the ten basic cloud types classified by the World Meteorological Organization. Composed of {高層|こうそう} (high level) and {雲|うん} (cloud). Despite the name containing {高|こう} (high), {高層雲|こうそううん} forms at middle altitudes. The name reflects an older Japanese classification system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高層雲|こうそううん}が{広|ひろ}がる — altostratus spreads
- {高層雲|こうそううん}に{覆|おお}われる — to be covered by altostratus
- {厚|あつ}い{高層雲|こうそううん} — thick altostratus

RELATED WORDS:
- {巻層雲|けんそううん} — cirrostratus (higher-altitude thin cloud layer)
- {乱層雲|らんそううん} — nimbostratus (rain-bearing cloud layer)
- {積乱雲|せきらんうん} — cumulonimbus (thundercloud)
- {雲|くも} — cloud (general term)
